categories.title: Thar Documents
categories.note: Source folder for firm papers: /Users/sunny/thar/jonga. e-RC + auth letter already laminated. TDS = sole prop on mom's PAN, so auth letter must be signed by mom (proprietor of record), not Shive.

items.label: Insurance certificate valid 9–23 May (Nepal rider OR plan to buy at border)
Authorization Letter — laminated, verified ✓ (mom-signed, Nepal-specific non-commercial language, notary stamp)
Mom's PAN copy — self-attested by her (from /Users/sunny/thar/jonga)
Mom's Aadhaar copy — self-attested by her (from /Users/sunny/thar/jonga)
Relationship proof — Shive's Aadhaar shows mom as parent OR birth certificate

categories.title: Personal Documents
categories.note: Indians don't need a passport for Nepal but it's the preferred ID at hotels and exchange counters.

items.label: Passport (preferred) + Voter ID + Aadhaar — both travellers
Travel insurance with mountain medical evacuation
Emergency contacts card (embassy, family, blood group)

categories.title: Border, Customs & Permits
categories.note: Complete Bhansar + Yatayat the day you cross at Sunauli. Pay 2–3 buffer days.

items.label: Bhansar (Customs) permit — buy with 2–3 day buffer
Yatayat (Transport) permit — buy with 2–3 day buffer
Customs declaration for both MacBook Pros (carry invoices)
ACAP permit (NPR 1,000/person SAARC) — at Pokhara NTB office
TIMS card — only if any trekking planned
Note 30-day cumulative count in phone (this trip = ~17–18 with buffer)

categories.title: Money
categories.note: INR 2000 notes are NOT accepted in Nepal. Mustang region = cash-only.

items.label: INR cash (100/200/500 notes only) — minimum INR 50,000
Debit card with international withdrawal flag enabled

categories.title: Connectivity & Hardware (Workation)
categories.note: Two MacBook Pros + invoices to defend personal-use customs status.

items.label: External SSD (1 TB encrypted) — pre-trip backup of Kotlin/Spring/Vue.js repos
NTC tourist SIM (better Mustang coverage) — at Bhairahawa, 2 photos + ID
Maps.me + Google Maps offline regions downloaded

categories.title: Vehicle Spares & Tools
categories.note: Beni–Jomsom is unforgiving. Tow rope and inflator are non-negotiable.

items.label: Stepney + jack + wheel spanner (stepney pressure verified)
Sealed 10 L jerrycan (fill at Beni, NOT at border)

categories.title: Medical Kit
categories.note: Muktinath = 3,800 m. Diamox prescription before departure, consult doctor.

items.label: Sunscreen SPF 50+, lip balm with SPF
Thermal innerwear (1 set) for Muktinath night
Inform bank / cards of Nepal travel
Backup work repos to SSD + cloud
Block work calendar 9–23 May; pre-schedule deliverables
Notify family of route + emergency contacts
Print every doc twice + photograph all to Drive/iCloud
Test 4WD low-ratio on a quiet road

categories.title: Daily Discipline (during trip)
categories.note: Quiet daily habits that save you from large problems later.

items.label: Log fuel + odometer at each fill-up
Charge MacBooks + power bank every evening
Cloud-sync work in Pokhara before any Mustang leg

categories.title: Return Day (Saturday 23 May)
categories.note: Closing the loop matters — for the day-count and for any future audit.

items.label: Surrender Bhansar + Yatayat at Sunauli — get exit stamp
Keep all Nepal receipts for 6 months
Photograph odometer at border + at home
